title: Encrypted Traffic Classification at Line Rate in Programmable Switches with Machine Learning
venue: NOMS 2024 - IEEE/IFIP Network Operations and Management Symposium
association_evidence: paper.pdf p.1 footnote 1 links exact repository
README.md lines 3,11,31-39 gives exact paper title/DOI and author citation
license: Unknown; no LICENSE/COPYING file; GitHub API license null
data_public: Partial: two NIMS derived CSVs and one RF pickle included; raw NIMS Dataport access/subscription may be required; Netflow QUIC and ISCX external links; full raw data not acquired
task: Encrypted flow classification after n=8 packets (NIMS IMA and ISCX VPN) or n=4 (Netflow QUIC)
input_unit: Directional flow keyed by src/dst IP, src/dst port, protocol; packet size and arrival-time statistics
model: Offline constrained RF hyperparameter/feature selection, Planter-style feature ranges and per-tree codeword tables, majority vote; offline unconstrained RF and XGBoost baselines
deployment: Training/baselines on CPU server; in-switch inference Intel Tofino TNA P4 + BFRT controller
gpu_dependency: No GPU required by inspected RF code; GPU experiment Unknown/not applicable to primary implementation
proprietary_hardware_software: Edgecore Wedge100BF-QS / Tofino BFN-T10-032Q, Intel SDE 9.7.0, P4 Insight and BFRT; not available or installed in audit

journal_extension.title: Real-Time Encrypted Traffic Classification in Programmable Networks with P4 and Machine Learning
journal_extension.audit_scope: Not independently audited; extra UC Davis/CSTNET scripts must not be counted as NOMS paper experiments

datasets: NIMS Encrypted Mobile Instant Messaging Traffic Dataset (6 IMA classes)
reproduction_level_scope: Bundled NIMS real-sample RF training/compression only; model-to-table generation separately tested; P4 compile/simulation/hardware R0, original paper metrics Unknown
